question: Who became the first Indian javelin ace to win the gold at the Zurich Diamond League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra** became the first Indian javelin ace to win the gold at the Zurich Diamond League.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the javelin throw.
 
• He is the reigning Olympic champion, having won the gold medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
